programs.description: Bangarraju falls in love with a city girl who already has three other suitors. With an invitation extended to all her admirers, he now faces the challenge of outshining his rivals and winning her heart.
Weekly show.
Meenakshi belongs to a middle-class family, but her life drastically changes when she falls in love with Radha Krishna Vanamali, a rich businessman.
After losing her boyfriend in a riot, a grieving woman is forced into marriage with another man. Later, her world is shaken when she discovers she's pregnant with her late lover's child.
Ammai Cute Abbai Naatu
Star Mahila
Ali Basha, a comedian from the Telugu entertainment industry, engages in a fun-filled conversation with renowned personalities.
After a young man finds Lord Yama's book that predicts the future, he uses it to earn money for his ancestral home. When Lord Yama finds the whereabouts of his misplaced book, he comes to claim it.
An anthology of captivating fairy tales exploring the five senses through magical stories that evoke sensory experiences in unique ways.
